points: Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with 1/4 tsp salt on high heat. Add the rice and cook for 10-12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Cook the Rice

points: Meanwhile, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium heat.
Once hot, add the tikka masala paste, tomato puree and garlic. Fry until fragrant, 1 min.
steps.title: Fry the Spices

points: Add the diced chicken, creme fraiche, chicken stock paste and the sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts) to the pan.
Stir together and season with salt and pepper.
Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce has thickened, 10-12 mins.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging. It's cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Simmer the Curry

points: When your chicken is cooked through, stir through the peas until piping hot, 1 min.
steps.title: Peas Please

points: Taste your chicken curry and season with salt and pepper if needed.
Fluff up the rice with a fork.
steps.title: Season to Taste

points: Share the rice between your bowls.
Top with the chicken tikka masala.
steps.title: Serve
